title: Total Knee Arthroplasty (TKA) for Severe Osteoarthritis
description: Coverage policy for elective total knee arthroplasty in adult patients with end-stage osteoarthritis. Requires documented range of motion flexion <= 90 degrees, failure of conservative therapy >= 180 days, and absence of active joint sepsis.
scope_note: Benchmark reference policy demonstrating zero-code declarative policy ingestion; not an exhaustive legal transcription of full multi-page CMS coverage manuals.

criteria.name: Severe Flexion Limitation (<= 90 degrees)
criteria.description: Physical exam documenting right or left knee range of motion with active flexion <= 90 degrees.

criteria.name: Failure of Conservative Therapy Duration
criteria.description: Failure of non-surgical conservative therapy (physical therapy, NSAIDs, injections) for >= 180 days.

criteria.name: Active Joint Infection Exclusion
criteria.description: Patient must not have active septic arthritis or active systemic infection.
